title: Guinea-Bissau calculator-readiness review — Batch 54
scope: Evidence refresh only. No calculator activation, formula change, merge or deployment.

new_evidence.source: FAO 50x2030 / DGPA Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development / INE

observations.coverage: national agricultural household listing and sampling frame

new_evidence.caveat: This is a household listing and sampling frame, not a full crop production census or crop-by-region yield survey. The 122,000 figure is an estimate. The crop and livestock activity indicators are household prevalence, not hectares, tonnes or yields.

new_evidence.topic: 2025 cereal production and regional production context
new_evidence.source: FAO GIEWS Country Brief on Guinea-Bissau
new_evidence.caveat: The 351,000-tonne figure is an aggregate cereal estimate, not a crop-specific or region-specific yield table. The regional description identifies major producing regions but does not quantify each region's production. Keep rice and coarse-grain crop-year timing distinct.

new_evidence.source: World Bank Real Time Food Prices dataset and WFP market monitoring system

observations.wfp_cashew_monitoring: weekly farm-gate cashew nut price updates during the marketing campaign

new_evidence.caveat: World Bank RTFP combines direct price observations with machine-learning estimates for missing data; retain its modelled/observed status and confidence metadata. The listed staple-food prices are not automatically farm-gate prices. WFP describes a direct weekly farm-gate cashew monitoring route, but the current dated cashew series still needs extraction and unit/grade validation.

new_evidence.topic: National statistical system and currency context
new_evidence.caveat: The INE indicator page labels some headline indicators as demo data. Use it for navigation/context only until the underlying official statistical tables are opened and verified. Agriculture's GDP share is not a crop yield, farm price or production cost.

regional_lookup.status: nine first-level regions confirmed by World Bank market dataset geographic coverage; Bissau is the autonomous sector
regional_lookup.note: Market dataset coverage does not establish crop production estimates for every region. Verify the current official administrative geography and spelling before wiring selectors.

criterion_status.regional_enterprise_budget_and_gross_mar: blocked_no validated crop- and region-specific enterprise budgets
criterion_status.calculator_mapping_and_test_cases: blocked_no Guinea-Bissau profile mapping or regression tests

blockers: Obtain crop-specific tables from the 2025 listing and the first full agricultural survey cycle (2026/2027); do not treat the listing as a crop census.
Extract region-by-crop harvested area, production, yield, production system and season from official DGPA/INE/FAO tables.
Obtain the current weekly WFP farm-gate cashew price series with date, region/market, grade, unit and currency; do not substitute imported rice retail prices.
Extract observed prices separately from World Bank machine-learning estimates and retain confidence and spatial interpolation flags.
Obtain farmer-paid seed, fertilizer, crop protection, irrigation, labour, machinery and land-preparation costs.
Prepare cashew-specific and food-crop regional enterprise budgets, then map only validated data to the 17 calculator commodities and add test cases.
safeguards: Do not treat the 2025 agricultural household listing as a crop production census.
Do not convert household crop prevalence into production or yield.
Do not assign the national 351,000-tonne cereal estimate to Oio, Cacheu or Biombo without source-backed regional figures.
Do not treat modelled World Bank prices as direct observations or farm-gate prices.
Do not use imported rice retail prices as producer prices.
Do not invent production costs or enterprise budgets.
Keep Guinea-Bissau research-only and preserve the original ten active country profiles.
next_step: Extract the WFP weekly farm-gate cashew series and official regional crop tables; then proceed to Lesotho if Guinea-Bissau's full cost and crop tables remain unavailable.
validation: Research note only; no calculator activation, merge or deployment.
